card.name: Handling cautions in device instructions
card.fires_on: Small words like not, NOT, avoid, over and a inside step-by-step instructions for syringes, caps, needles and implants, just before a handling action is named.

modes.label: Do not warnings
modes.description: The word not or NOT right after do, warning about touching or forcing a part.

modes.label: Care and avoid phrases
modes.description: Words like avoid, over or that in phrases such as taking care to avoid or without over tightening.
modes.example: taking care to<< avoid>> touching the plunger rod

modes.label: Direction of motion
modes.description: The article before a turning or pulling direction in assembly steps.
modes.example: syringe in<< a>> clockwise direction until it is firmly attached

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about alignment and positioning, and away from code-like tokens.
card.plain: It lights up on the small words in injection-device steps that warn you what not to do or how to turn or pull a part.
